cfn_description: Gateway Stack - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration
user_prompt: We need a CloudFormation template that deploys an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration to support an AI agent for protein variant effect prediction. The template should not provision the backend compute or authentication providers; instead, it must dynamically resolve existing configuration from SSM Parameter Store. Create an IAM role for the 'bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com' service that grants permission to invoke a Lambda function (retrieving the Lambda ARN dynamically from SSM) and store this new IAM role's ARN in a standard SSM parameter. Provision the AgentCore Gateway configured with a custom JWT authorizer that dynamically references a Cognito discovery URL and client ID from SSM. Next, create a gateway target connecting the gateway to the Lambda function, defining an MCP inline tool schema with 'invoke_endpoint' and 'get_results' operations for submitting sequences and checking job completion. Include parameters for the project name (defaulting to 'protein-engineering'), gateway description, and an optional gateway name that auto-generates from the project name if left blank.
cfn_code:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Gateway Stack - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration'

# ============================================================================
# TEMPLATE OVERVIEW
# ============================================================================
# This CloudFormation template deploys Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
# with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration for AI agent communication.
#
# Key Components:
# - IAM Role for AgentCore Gateway with Lambda invoke permissions
# - AgentCore Gateway with JWT authorization (Cognito integration)
# - Gateway Target connecting to Lambda function for protein prediction
# - MCP tool schema defining invoke_endpoint and get_results operations
#
# Dependencies:
# - VEP Stack: Requires Lambda function ARN from SSM Parameter Store
# - Cognito Stack: Requires discovery URL and client ID from SSM Parameter Store
#
# Stack Deployment Order:
# 1. VEP Endpoint Stack (creates Lambda, stores ARN in SSM)
# 2. Cognito Stack (creates auth config, stores in SSM)
# 3. Gateway Stack (reads from SSM, creates gateway) <- THIS STACK
#
# Outputs:
# - Gateway URL for MCP client connections
# - Gateway ID and ARN for reference
# - IAM role information
# ============================================================================

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'Project Configuration'
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
      - Label:
          default: 'Gateway Configuration'
        Parameters:
          - GatewayName
          - GatewayDescription
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: 'Project Name'
      GatewayName:
        default: 'Gateway Name'
      GatewayDescription:
        default: 'Gateway Description'

# ============================================================================
# PARAMETERS
# ============================================================================
# Configure Gateway naming and description
# ============================================================================

Parameters:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Project Configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'protein-engineering'
    Description: 'Project name used for resource naming and tagging'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Name for the AgentCore Gateway (leave empty to auto-generate from project name)'
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores'

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: 'AgentCore Gateway for protein engineering agent with MCP integration'
    Description: 'Description for the AgentCore Gateway'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

# ============================================================================
# CONDITIONS
# ============================================================================
Conditions:
  UseGeneratedGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

# ============================================================================
# RESOURCES
# ============================================================================
Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM ROLE FOR AGENTCORE GATEWAY
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Allows Gateway to invoke Lambda function for protein prediction
  # Uses dynamic SSM reference to get Lambda ARN from VEP stack
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    # Purpose: Grants AgentCore Gateway permission to invoke Lambda function
    # Trust Policy: Only bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com can assume this role
    # Conditions: Restricts to same account and AgentCore service ARNs
    # Permissions: lambda:InvokeFunction on specific Lambda (from SSM)
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: 'Execution role for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke Lambda functions'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'LambdaInvokeAccess'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource: '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/lambda-function-arn}}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: Gateway
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM PARAMETER FOR GATEWAY ROLE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stores Gateway role ARN for reference (optional, for future use)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    # Purpose: Stores Gateway IAM role ARN for reference
    # Usage: Can be used by monitoring or management tools
    Properties:
      Name: '/protein-agent/gateway/role-arn'
      Description: 'AgentCore Gateway IAM role ARN'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Tier: Standard
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AGENTCORE GATEWAY
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main gateway resource that provides MCP endpoint for AI agents
  # Configured with JWT authorization using Cognito
  # Uses dynamic SSM references to retrieve Cognito configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    # Purpose: Creates MCP-compatible gateway for AI agent communication
    # Protocol: MCP (Model Context Protocol) with SEMANTIC search
    # Authorization: CUSTOM_JWT using Cognito for token validation
    # Dynamic References: Retrieves Cognito config from SSM at deployment time
    Properties:
      Name: !If [UseGeneratedGatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway', !Ref GatewayName]
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url}}'
          AllowedClients:
            - '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/cognito/client-id}}'
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SearchType: SEMANTIC
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: Gateway
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GATEWAY TARGET
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Connects Gateway to Lambda function with MCP tool schema
  # Defines invoke_endpoint and get_results operations
  # Uses dynamic SSM reference to retrieve Lambda ARN from VEP stack
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    # Purpose: Connects Gateway to Lambda function for protein prediction
    # Tool Schema: Defines two MCP tools (invoke_endpoint, get_results)
    # Credentials: Uses Gateway IAM role for Lambda invocation
    # Dynamic Reference: Retrieves Lambda ARN from SSM at deployment time
    Properties:
      Name: 'protein-engineering-lambda'
      Description: 'Lambda target for protein variant effect prediction'
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/lambda-function-arn}}'
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: 'invoke_endpoint'
                  Description: 'Submit a job to predict the variant effects for an amino acid sequence'
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: 'object'
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: 'string'
                        Description: 'Amino acid sequence'
                    Required:
                      - 'sequence'
                - Name: 'get_results'
                  Description: 'Check if a variant effect prediction job has completed and retrieve results'
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: 'object'
                    Properties:
                      output_id:
                        Type: 'string'
                        Description: 'output_id returned by invoke_endpoint'
                    Required:
                      - 'output_id'
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUTS
# ============================================================================
# Provides Gateway connection information and resource identifiers
# ============================================================================

Outputs:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Outputs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayId:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway ID'
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayId'

  GatewayUrl:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway MCP URL'
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayUrl'

  GatewayArn:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayArn'

  # IAM Role Outputs
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway IAM role ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArn'

  GatewayRoleName:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway IAM role name'
    Value: !Ref GatewayRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleName'

  # Target Outputs
  TargetId:
    Description: 'Gateway Target ID'
    Value: !Ref GatewayTarget
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetId'

  TargetName:
    Description: 'Gateway Target name'
    Value: 'protein-engineering-lambda'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetName'

  # SSM Parameter Outputs
  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: 'SSM Parameter name for Gateway role ARN'
    Value: '/protein-agent/gateway/role-arn'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArnParameter'

  # Configuration Outputs
  ProjectName:
    Description: 'Project name used for resource naming'
    Value: !Ref ProjectName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ProjectName'

  GatewayName:
    Description: 'Gateway name'
    Value: !If [UseGeneratedGatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway', !Ref GatewayName]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayName'

cfn_description: SERA ALB WAF - Web Application Firewall for Application Load Balancer - Multi-Stack Support
user_prompt: We need a CloudFormation template that creates a regional Web Application Firewall (WAFv2) for an Application Load Balancer. The stack must use a customizable prefix parameter (defaulting to 'sera', 3-21 lowercase characters) to name resources, and must accept two additional parameters for external dependencies: the ARN of an existing Application Load Balancer and the ARN of an existing KMS key. The WAF should allow traffic by default and include two rate limit rules: one blocking IPs exceeding 2000 requests per 5 minutes, and a stricter one blocking IPs exceeding 1000 requests per 5 minutes for URI paths containing '/api/'. Additionally, enable the AWS managed rule groups for common threats, known bad inputs, SQL injection, Linux operating system protection, and IP reputation. Associate the WAF with the provided ALB parameter, and configure CloudWatch logging (with 10-year retention, encrypted using the provided KMS key parameter), ensuring a logging filter is applied to only keep entries where the action was COUNT.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SERA ALB WAF - Web Application Firewall for Application Load Balancer - Multi-Stack Support'

Parameters:
  StackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Unique prefix for this SERA deployment (e.g., sera-prod, sera-dev, sera-partner1)'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be 3-21 characters, lowercase, start with letter, hyphens allowed'
    Default: 'sera'
  ALBArn:
    Type: String
    Description: 'ARN of the existing Application Load Balancer to associate with the WAF'
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: 'ARN of the existing KMS Key used to encrypt CloudWatch logs'

Resources:
  # WAF Web ACL for ALB
  ALBWAFWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Metadata:
      checkov:
        skip:
          - id: CKV_AWS_192
            comment: "WAF includes AWS Managed Rules for comprehensive protection including SQLi, XSS, and known bad inputs. Application is Python-based with proper input validation."
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf'
      Description: !Sub 'WAF for ${StackPrefix} Application Load Balancer'
      Scope: REGIONAL
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}

      Rules:
        # Rate limiting for general traffic (custom rule - uses Action)
        - Name: GeneralRateLimit

The user pool must enforce a password policy requiring a minimum length of 11 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols, with temporary passwords valid for 7 days, and email verification should use a confirmation code with the subject "Your verification code" and message "Your verification code is {####}". The authenticated IAM role should include an inline policy granting S3 object-level permissions (put, get, delete, and tagging) on a bucket named with the pattern "nih-grants-context-{region}-{accountId}", KMS GenerateDataKey and Decrypt permissions restricted to requests using the alias "nih-grants-s3-key", and API Gateway WebSocket connect permission on any API in the account and region. The identity pool must be linked to both app clients and the authenticated and unauthenticated roles should be attached via a role mapping.

Description: >-
  {"createdOn":"Mac","createdBy":"Amplify","createdWith":"11.0.3","stackType":"auth-Cognito","metadata":{}}
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Parameters:
  NIHCONTEXTBUCKET:
    Type: String
    Default: "xxxxxxxxxxxx"

    Type: String
    Default: "false"

    Type: String

Resources:

  IDPUnauthRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      Description: "This role is assumed by cognito "
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !GetAtt
                  - IdentityPool
                  - Name
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
  IDPAuthRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      Description: "This role is assumed by cognito "
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated

  IDPAuthRoleS3Policy:
    #
    DependsOn: IDPAuthRole
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Policy'
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: W12
            reason: "Wildcard resource is restricted by condition to only a specific kms key"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: nih-grants-cognito-auth-role
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 's3:PutObject'
              - 's3:PutObjectTagging'
              - 's3:PutObjectAcl'
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:DeleteObject'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:RequestAlias': 'alias/nih-grants-s3-key'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'execute-api:Invoke'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/$connect'
      Roles:
        - !Ref IDPAuthRole

  UserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: []
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      EmailVerificationMessage: !Ref emailVerificationMessage
      EmailVerificationSubject: !Ref emailVerificationSubject
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: !Ref passwordPolicyMinLength
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Schema:
        - Mutable: true
          Name: email
          Required: true
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      UserPoolName: !Sub
            - "nih-grants-cognito-pool-${region}-${accountid}"
            - region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              accountid: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  UserPoolClientWeb:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub
            - "nih-grants-app-client-web-${region}-${accountid}"
            - region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              accountid: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      RefreshTokenValidity: !Ref userpoolClientRefreshTokenValidity
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
    DependsOn:
      - UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub
            - "nih-grants-app-client-${region}-${accountid}"
            - region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              accountid: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      GenerateSecret: !Ref userpoolClientGenerateSecret
      RefreshTokenValidity: !Ref userpoolClientRefreshTokenValidity
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
    DependsOn:
      - UserPool

  IdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: !Ref allowUnauthenticatedIdentities
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub
            - "cognito-idp.${region}.amazonaws.com/${client}"
            - region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              client: !Ref UserPool
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClientWeb
          ProviderName: !Sub
            - "cognito-idp.${region}.amazonaws.com/${client}"
            - region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              client: !Ref UserPool
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub
            - "nih-grants-identity-pool-${region}-${accountid}"
            - region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              accountid: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
  IdentityPoolRoleMap:
    DependsOn: [IDPAuthRole,IdentityPool]
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt
        - IDPUnauthRole
        - Arn
        authenticated: !GetAtt
        - IDPAuthRole
        - Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Id for the identity pool
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  IdentityPoolName:
    Description: Name for the identity pool
    Value: !GetAtt
      - IdentityPool
      - Name
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Id for the user pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Arn for the user pool
    Value: !GetAtt
      - UserPool
      - Arn
  UserPoolName:
    Value: !Sub "nih-grants-cognito-pool-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
  AppClientIDWeb:
    Description: The user pool app client id for web
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClientWeb
  AppClientID:
    Description: The user pool app client id
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

    Description: "Authenticated role ARN for Cognito Identity Pool"
    Value: !GetAtt IDPAuthRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IDPAuthRole'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: "AWS Backup template to back up all resources tagged with backup key with following values (daily - each day at 5AM UTC, weekly - each Sunday at 5AM UTC, and monthly - 1st day of each month at 5AM UTC). Backup retention can be modified as required (by default: daily - 14 days, weekly - 56 days, and monthly - 365 days). Service Catalog Tag Option key-value pairs are provisioned for integration with Portfolios and Products. (fdp-1r4squ5n0)"

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "Encryption key for backups"
      EnableKeyRotation: True
      Enabled: True
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            "AWS": { "Fn::Sub": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root" }
          Action:
          - kms:*
          Resource: "*"

  BackupVaultWithDailyBackups:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupVault"
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: "BackupVaultWithDailyBackups"
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  BackupVaultWithWeeklyBackups:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupVault"
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: "BackupVaultWithWeeklyBackups"
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  BackupVaultWithMonthlyBackups:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupVault"
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: "BackupVaultWithMonthlyBackups"
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  BackupPlanWithDailyBackups:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupPlan"
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: "BackupPlanWithDailyBackups"
        BackupPlanRule:
          -
            RuleName: "RuleWithDailyBackups"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVaultWithDailyBackups
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(15 5 ? * * *)"
            Lifecycle:
                DeleteAfterDays: 14

    DependsOn: BackupVaultWithDailyBackups

  BackupPlanWithWeeklyBackups:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupPlan"
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: "BackupPlanWithWeeklyBackups"
        BackupPlanRule:
          -
            RuleName: "RuleWithWeeklyBackups"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVaultWithWeeklyBackups
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(15 5 ? * 1 *)"
            Lifecycle:
                DeleteAfterDays: 56

    DependsOn: BackupVaultWithWeeklyBackups

  BackupPlanWithMonthlyBackups:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupPlan"
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: "BackupPlanWithMonthlyBackups"
        BackupPlanRule:
          -
            RuleName: "RuleWithMonthlyBackups"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVaultWithMonthlyBackups
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(15 5 1 * ? *)"
            Lifecycle:
                DeleteAfterDays: 365

    DependsOn: BackupVaultWithMonthlyBackups

  BackupRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
     AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
       Version: "2012-10-17"
       Statement:
         -
          Effect: "Allow"
          Principal:
            Service:
              - "backup.amazonaws.com"
          Action:
            - "sts:AssumeRole"
     ManagedPolicyArns:
       -
        "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup"

  TagBasedBackupSelectionDaily:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupSelection"
    Properties:
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: "TagBasedBackupSelectionDaily"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
         -
           ConditionType: "STRINGEQUALS"
           ConditionKey: "backup"
           ConditionValue: "daily"
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlanWithDailyBackups
    DependsOn: BackupPlanWithDailyBackups

  TagBasedBackupSelectionWeekly:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupSelection"
    Properties:
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: "TagBasedBackupSelectionWeekly"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
         -
           ConditionType: "STRINGEQUALS"
           ConditionKey: "backup"
           ConditionValue: "weekly"
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlanWithWeeklyBackups
    DependsOn: BackupPlanWithWeeklyBackups

  TagBasedBackupSelectionMonthly:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupSelection"
    Properties:
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: "TagBasedBackupSelectionMonthly"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
         -
           ConditionType: "STRINGEQUALS"
           ConditionKey: "backup"
           ConditionValue: "monthly"
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlanWithMonthlyBackups
    DependsOn: BackupPlanWithMonthlyBackups

  TagOptiondailybackup:
    Type: 'AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption'
    Properties:
      Active: true
      Value: daily
      Key: backup

  TagOptionweeklybackup:
    Type: 'AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption'
    Properties:
      Active: true
      Value: weekly
      Key: backup

  TagOptionmonthlybackup:
    Type: 'AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption'
    Properties:
      Active: true
      Value: monthly
      Key: backup

Outputs:

    Description: The KMS Key used for Encryption of backups
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

cfn_description: EKS managed node groups for EMR on EKS Spark workloads. Creates a general node group for system pods and a Spark node group for EMR executor pods, plus the EBS CSI driver addon.
user_prompt: We need a CloudFormation template that creates its own EKS cluster, two private subnets in the first two available availability zones, and the required security groups (an EMR cluster security group and an EMR Celeborn access security group) so that the entire environment is self-contained, then provisions managed node groups for EMR on EKS Spark workloads: a general node group for system pods with m5.xlarge instances, min/desired size of 2 and max of 3, and a Spark node group for executor pods with memory-optimized r5.2xlarge instances, min/desired size of 3 and max of 6, both on-demand using Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 standard AMI with 50 GB disk and attaching a launch template that references the newly created security groups, along with an IAM role for the node groups containing the AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy, AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy, AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly, and AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policies, and a separate IAM role for the EBS CSI driver with the AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy to be used later for IRSA (without deploying the addon), with all instance types, scaling sizes, and a project name parameter defaulting to "emr-celeborn-demo" parameterized, and exporting the two node group names and the CSI driver role name as stack outputs.
cfn_code:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  EKS managed node groups for EMR on EKS Spark workloads.
  Creates a general node group for system pods and a Spark node group
  for EMR executor pods, plus the EBS CSI driver addon.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General Node Group
        Parameters:
          - GeneralInstanceType
          - GeneralMinSize
          - GeneralDesiredSize
          - GeneralMaxSize
      - Label:
          default: Spark Node Group
        Parameters:
          - SparkInstanceType
          - SparkMinSize
          - SparkDesiredSize
          - SparkMaxSize
      - Label:
          default: Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-celeborn-demo
    Description: Project name used to import exports and for tagging

  GeneralInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.xlarge
    Description: EC2 instance type for general worker nodes

  GeneralMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Minimum number of general nodes

  GeneralDesiredSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired number of general nodes

  GeneralMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Maximum number of general nodes

  SparkInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: r5.2xlarge
    Description: EC2 instance type for Spark executor nodes (memory-optimized)

  SparkMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Minimum number of Spark nodes

  SparkDesiredSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Desired number of Spark nodes

  SparkMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Maximum number of Spark nodes

Resources:
  # --- Node Group IAM Role ---

  NodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: W28
            reason: "Explicit role name required for IRSA trust policy binding in the deploy script. This is a blog post demonstration — resource replacement constraints are not a concern."
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-node-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-node-role"
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # --- EBS CSI Driver IAM Role (trust policy updated via deploy script for IRSA) ---

  EBSCSIDriverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: W28
            reason: "Explicit role name required for IRSA trust policy binding in the deploy script. This is a blog post demonstration — resource replacement constraints are not a concern."
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-ebs-csi-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-ebs-csi-role"
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # --- Launch Template for Spark Nodes (attaches shared-infra EMR security group) ---

  SparkLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-spark-nodes-lt"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !ImportValue
            Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-EmrClusterSgId"
          - !ImportValue
            Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-EmrCelebornAccessSgId"
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-spark-node"
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # --- General Node Group (system pods: CoreDNS, kube-proxy, etc.) ---

  GeneralNodeGroup:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Nodegroup
    Properties:
      NodegroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-general"
      ClusterName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-EmrClusterName"
      NodeRole: !GetAtt NodeGroupRole.Arn
      Subnets:
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref GeneralInstanceType
      ScalingConfig:
        MinSize: !Ref GeneralMinSize
        DesiredSize: !Ref GeneralDesiredSize
        MaxSize: !Ref GeneralMaxSize
      AmiType: AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD
      CapacityType: ON_DEMAND
      DiskSize: 50
      Labels:
        node-type: general
        node-lifecycle: on-demand
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-general-nodes"
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  # --- Spark Node Group (EMR executor pods) ---

  SparkNodeGroup:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Nodegroup
    Properties:
      NodegroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-spark"
      ClusterName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-EmrClusterName"
      NodeRole: !GetAtt NodeGroupRole.Arn
      Subnets:
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: "${ProjectName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"
      LaunchTemplate:
        Id: !Ref SparkLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt SparkLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref SparkInstanceType
      ScalingConfig:
        MinSize: !Ref SparkMinSize
        DesiredSize: !Ref SparkDesiredSize
        MaxSize: !Ref SparkMaxSize
      AmiType: AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD
      CapacityType: ON_DEMAND
      Labels:
        node-type: spark
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-spark-nodes"
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  # --- EBS CSI Driver Addon ---
  # NOTE: The aws-ebs-csi-driver addon is NOT deployed here because it requires
  # an IRSA trust policy on EBSCSIDriverRole. The OIDC provider is only available
  # after the EKS cluster stack deploys, so the trust policy cannot be set in
  # CloudFormation at stack-creation time. Without the correct trust policy, the
  # addon pods cannot assume the role, they crash-loop, and CloudFormation hangs
  # indefinitely in CREATE_IN_PROGRESS.
  # The addon is instead installed via CLI in deploy.sh after OIDC/IRSA setup.

Outputs:
  GeneralNodeGroupName:
    Description: Name of the general node group
    Value: !Ref GeneralNodeGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-EmrGeneralNodeGroup"

  SparkNodeGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Spark node group
    Value: !Ref SparkNodeGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-EmrSparkNodeGroup"

  EBSCSIDriverRoleName:
    Description: IAM role name for EBS CSI driver (trust policy updated by deploy script)
    Value: !Ref EBSCSIDriverRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-EmrEBSCSIRoleName"

cfn_description: FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — SLO Dashboard. イベント駆動パイプラインの SLO 可視化ダッシュボードとアラーム。
user_prompt: We need a CloudFormation template that creates a self-contained SLO monitoring dashboard and associated CloudWatch alarms for an event-driven pipeline pattern based on FSx for ONTAP, with the following objectives: the template must define four SLO alarms—EventIngestionLatency (P99 threshold of 5 seconds), ProcessingSuccessRate (average threshold of 99.5%), FPolicyReconnectTime (maximum threshold of 30 seconds), and ReplayCompletionTime (maximum threshold of 5 minutes)—each evaluated over three consecutive 5-minute periods with missing data treated as not breaching, and all alarms should optionally forward to an SNS topic if an ARN is provided, but the template must create all other resources itself without relying on pre-existing components. Additionally, the template must create a CloudWatch dashboard that includes time-series metric widgets for each of those four SLO metrics with visual annotations at their thresholds, along with synthetic canary monitoring widgets for S3AP latency (list and get latencies) and ONTAP health check from a separate canary metric namespace, and an alarm status widget listing all four SLO alarms. The entire dashboard and alarm set should only be deployed when an explicit enable flag is set to true (defaulting to false), using a project prefix defaulting to "fsxn-s3ap", a metric namespace defaulting to "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns", and a canary metric namespace defaulting to "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary", while the region should default to us-east-1 and all thresholds must be configurable via parameters.
cfn_code:
# =============================================================================
# SLO Dashboard — CloudWatch Dashboard + Alarms
# =============================================================================
#
# イベント駆動パイプラインの SLO（Service Level Objectives）を定義し、
# CloudWatch ダッシュボードと SLO アラームで可視化する。
#
# SLO ターゲット:
#   1. EventIngestionLatency — P99 < 5 seconds
#   2. ProcessingSuccessRate — > 99.5%
#   3. ReconnectTime — < 30 seconds
#   4. ReplayCompletionTime — < 5 minutes
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/slo-dashboard.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-slo-dashboard \
#     --parameter-overrides EnableSLODashboard=true
#
# オプトイン制御:
#   EnableSLODashboard=false (デフォルト) でリソースは作成されない。
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — SLO Dashboard.
  イベント駆動パイプラインの SLO 可視化ダッシュボードとアラーム。

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  EnableSLODashboard:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: SLO Dashboard 機能を有効化する

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns"
    Description: CloudWatch メトリクス名前空間

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary"
    Description: Synthetic Monitoring Canary メトリクス名前空間

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: SLO 違反通知用 SNS Topic ARN

  IngestionLatencyThresholdMs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5000
    Description: EventIngestionLatency SLO 閾値（ミリ秒、P99）

  SuccessRateThresholdPct:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: ProcessingSuccessRate SLO 閾値（%）

  ReconnectTimeThresholdSec:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: ReconnectTime SLO 閾値（秒）

  ReplayCompletionThresholdSec:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: ReplayCompletionTime SLO 閾値（秒）

Conditions:
  IsSLODashboardEnabled:
    !Equals [!Ref EnableSLODashboard, "true"]

Resources:
  # --- CloudWatch Alarms ---
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-ingestion-latency"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: EventIngestionLatency P99 > 5s"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency_ms
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref IngestionLatencyThresholdMs
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-success-rate"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: ProcessingSuccessRate < 99.5%"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate_pct
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref SuccessRateThresholdPct
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  ReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-reconnect-time"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: FPolicyReconnectTime > 30s"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime_sec
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReconnectTimeThresholdSec
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-replay-completion"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: ReplayCompletionTime > 5min"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime_sec
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionThresholdSec
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  # --- CloudWatch Dashboard ---
  SLODashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard"
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99) — SLO < ${IngestionLatencyThresholdMs}ms",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency_ms", {"stat": "p99"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${IngestionLatencyThresholdMs}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Processing Success Rate — SLO > ${SuccessRateThresholdPct}%",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate_pct", {"stat": "Average"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${SuccessRateThresholdPct}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time — SLO < ${ReconnectTimeThresholdSec}s",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime_sec", {"stat": "Maximum"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${ReconnectTimeThresholdSec}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Replay Completion Time — SLO < ${ReplayCompletionThresholdSec}s",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime_sec", {"stat": "Maximum"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${ReplayCompletionThresholdSec}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 1,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "## Synthetic Monitoring — S3AP & ONTAP Health (Feature 3 Integration)"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 13,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "S3AP Latency (Synthetic Canary)",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3AP_ListLatency_ms", {"stat": "Average", "label": "List Latency"}],
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3AP_GetLatency_ms", {"stat": "Average", "label": "Get Latency"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 13,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "ONTAP Health Check (Synthetic Canary)",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "ONTAP_HealthCheck", {"stat": "Minimum", "label": "Health (1=OK, 0=Fail)"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "alarm",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 19,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 3,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                "alarms": [
                  "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn}"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: SLO Dashboard 名
    Value: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DashboardName"

  IngestionLatencyAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: EventIngestionLatency Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IngestionLatencyAlarmArn"

  SuccessRateAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: ProcessingSuccessRate Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SuccessRateAlarmArn"

  ReconnectTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: ReconnectTime Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReconnectTimeAlarmArn"

  ReplayCompletionAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: ReplayCompletionTime Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReplayCompletionAlarmArn"

cfn_description: Budgets example
user_prompt: We need a CloudFormation template that creates monthly COST budgets for our key security and monitoring services, including AWS Config, CloudWatch, GuardDuty, Inspector, Security Hub, and S3 for security logs, with budget limits of $10,000 for Config and CloudWatch and $1,000 for the remaining services; each budget must be of type COST with a MONTHLY time unit, a defined time period that starts in the past and extends to a distant end date, and the required cost type settings that include recurring, subscription, other-subscription, and upfront charges while excluding credits, discounts, refunds, support, and tax, and the budgets must be retained even if the stack is deleted.
cfn_code:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Budgets example
Resources:

  AWSConfig:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: '10000.0'
          Unit: USD
        BudgetName: AWS-Config
        BudgetType: COST
        CostFilters:
          Service:
            - AWS Config
        CostTypes:
          IncludeCredit: false
          IncludeDiscount: false
          IncludeOtherSubscription: true
          IncludeRecurring: true
          IncludeRefund: false
          IncludeSubscription: true
          IncludeSupport: false
          IncludeTax: false
          IncludeUpfront: true
          UseAmortized: true
          UseBlended: false
        TimePeriod:
          End: '2087-06-15T10:00:00+10:00'
          Start: '2023-05-01T10:00:00+10:00'
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY

  AWSCloudwatch:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: '10000.0'
          Unit: USD
        BudgetName: AWS-Cloudwatch
        BudgetType: COST
        CostFilters:
          LinkedAccount:
            - '111111111111'
            - '222222222222'
          Service:
            - AmazonCloudWatch
            - CloudWatch Events
        CostTypes:
          IncludeCredit: false
          IncludeDiscount: false
          IncludeOtherSubscription: true
          IncludeRecurring: true
          IncludeRefund: false
          IncludeSubscription: true
          IncludeSupport: true
          IncludeTax: false
          IncludeUpfront: true
          UseAmortized: true
          UseBlended: false
        TimePeriod:
          End: '2087-06-15T10:00:00+10:00'
          Start: '2022-02-01T11:00:00+10:00'
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY

  AWSGuardDuty:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: '1000.0'
          Unit: USD

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploy a service on AWS Fargate, hosted in a private subnet, but accessible via a public load balancer.
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: The name of the environment to add this service to
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: A name for the service
  ImageUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: The url of a docker image that contains the application process that
                 will handle the traffic for this service
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: What port number the application inside the docker container is binding to
  ContainerCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU
  ContainerMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container
  Path:
    Type: String
    Default: "*"
    Description: A path on the load balancer that this service
                 should be connected to. Use * to send all load balancer
                 traffic to this service.
  Priority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: The priority for the routing rule added to the load balancer.
                 This only applies if your have multiple services which have been
                 assigned to different paths on the load balancer.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: How many copies of the service task to run
  Role:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: (Optional) An IAM role to give the service's containers if the code within needs to
                 access other AWS resources like S3 buckets, DynamoDB tables, etc

Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [ !Equals [!Ref 'Role', ''] ]

Resources:
  #Um grupo de logs para armazenar os logs stdout dos contêineres deste serviço
  LogGrupo:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-${ServiceName}

  # A definição da tarefa. Esta é uma descrição simples de metadados do que
  # contêiner a ser executado e quais requisitos de recursos ele possui.
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
      Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ECSTaskExecutionRole
      TaskRoleArn:
        Fn::If:
          - 'HasCustomRole'
          - !Ref 'Role'
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref 'ServiceName'
          Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
          Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
          Image: !Ref 'ImageUrl'
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: 'awslogs'
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-${ServiceName}
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref 'ServiceName'

  # O serviço. O serviço é um recurso que permite executar vários
  # cópias de um tipo de tarefa e reúna seus logs e métricas também
  # como monitorar o número de tarefas em execução e substituir qualquer uma que tenha travado
  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: LoadBalancerRule
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cluster:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ClusterName
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
      DesiredCount: !Ref 'DesiredCount'
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:PrivateSubnetOne
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:PrivateSubnetTwo
      TaskDefinition: !Ref 'TaskDefinition'
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: !Ref 'ServiceName'
          ContainerPort: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref 'TargetGroup'

  #Um grupo-alvo. Isto é usado para manter o controle de todas as tarefas, e
  # quais endereços IP/números de porta eles têm. Você mesmo pode consultar,
  # para usar os endereços você mesmo, mas na maioria das vezes esse grupo-alvo é apenas
  # conectado a um balanceador de carga de aplicativo ou balanceador de carga de rede, então
  # pode distribuir automaticamente o tráfego entre todos os alvos.
  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 6
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      TargetType: ip
      Name: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Port: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
      Protocol: HTTP
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      VpcId:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:VpcId

  #Crie uma regra no balanceador de carga para rotear o tráfego para o grupo de destino
  LoadBalancerRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      Actions:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref 'TargetGroup'
          Type: 'forward'
      Conditions:
        - Field: path-pattern
          Values: [!Ref 'Path']
      ListenerArn:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:PublicListener
      Priority: !Ref 'Priority'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploy a service into an ECS cluster with service discovery endpoint
Parameters:

    Type: String

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: A name for the service
  ImageUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx

  ContainerMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: How many copies of the service task to run
  Role:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: (Optional) An IAM role to give the service's containers if the code within needs to
      access other AWS resources like S3 buckets, DynamoDB tables, etc

Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [ !Equals [!Ref 'Role', ''] ]

Resources:
  # A log group for storing the stdout logs from this service's containers
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-${ServiceName}

  # The task definition. This is a simple metadata description of what
  # container to run, and what resource requirements it has.
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
      Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
      TaskRoleArn:
        Fn::If:
          - 'HasCustomRole'
          - !Ref 'Role'
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref 'ServiceName'
          Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
          Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
          Image: !Ref 'ImageUrl'
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: 'awslogs'
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-${ServiceName}
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref 'ServiceName'

  # The service. The service is a resource which allows you to run multiple
  # copies of a type of task, and gather up their logs and metrics, as well
  # as monitor the number of running tasks and replace any that have crashed
  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: ServiceDiscoveryService
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cluster:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ClusterName
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
      DesiredCount: !Ref 'DesiredCount'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref 'TaskDefinition'
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerPort: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
          ContainerName: !Ref 'ServiceName'

  # Create a service discovery service in the private service namespace.
  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords: [{Type: SRV, TTL: "10"}]
        NamespaceId:
          Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:PrivateServiceDiscoveryNamespace
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  # Enable autoscaling for this service
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: Service
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: 'ecs'
      ScalableDimension: 'ecs:service:DesiredCount'
      ResourceId:
        Fn::Join:
          - '/'
          - - service
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ClusterName
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:AutoscalingRole

  # Create scaling policies for the service
  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '/'
          - - scale
            - !Ref 'EnvironmentName'
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
            - down
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ResourceId:
        Fn::Join:
          - '/'
          - - service
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ClusterName
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
      ScalableDimension: 'ecs:service:DesiredCount'
      ServiceNamespace: 'ecs'
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: 'ChangeInCapacity'
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1
        MetricAggregationType: 'Average'
        Cooldown: 60

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '/'
          - - scale
            - !Ref 'EnvironmentName'
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
            - up
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ResourceId:
        Fn::Join:
          - '/'
          - - service
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ClusterName
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
      ScalableDimension: 'ecs:service:DesiredCount'
      ServiceNamespace: 'ecs'
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: 'ChangeInCapacity'
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1

            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
        MetricAggregationType: 'Average'
        Cooldown: 60

  # Create alarms to trigger these policies
  LowCpuUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '-'
          - - low-cpu
            - !Ref 'EnvironmentName'
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
      AlarmDescription:
        Fn::Join:
          - ' '
          - - "Low CPU utilization for service"
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
            - "in environment"
            - !Ref 'EnvironmentName'
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref 'ServiceName'
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}:ClusterName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

  HighCpuUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName:
        Fn::Join:
          - '-'
          - - high-cpu
            - !Ref 'EnvironmentName'
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
      AlarmDescription:
        Fn::Join:
          - ' '
          - - "High CPU utilization for service"
            - !Ref 'ServiceName'
            - "in environment"
            - !Ref 'EnvironmentName'
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Dimensions:

        - Name: ClusterName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Block application network traffic from experiment Region to target Region and pause cross-Region replication

Parameters:

  MultiRegionScenario:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: Block application network traffic from experiment Region to target Region and pause cross-Region replication
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ExperimentRole.Arn
      Targets:
        TransitGateway:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref TransitGatewayTagValue

        Subnet:

          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref SubnetTagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3Bucket:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref S3BucketTagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL

          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref DynamoDBTagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL
      Actions:

          ActionId: aws:network:transit-gateway-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity

            duration: !Ref Duration
            region: !Ref Region
          Targets:

        DisruptSubnetConnectivity:

          - id: AwsSolutions-IAM5
            reason: "Wildcard permissions are required for FIS experiments to cover prefix lists."

          - id: AwsSolutions-IAM5
            reason: "Wildcard permissions are required for FIS experiments to cover subnets."
            appliesTo: ["Resource::arn:aws:ec2:*:*:subnet/*"]
          - id: AwsSolutions-IAM5
            reason: "Wildcard permissions are required for FIS experiments to cover security groups."
            appliesTo: ["Resource::arn:aws:ec2:*:*:security-group/*"]

          - id: AwsSolutions-IAM5

            appliesTo: ["Resource::arn:aws:ec2:*:*:vpc-endpoint/*"]
          - id: AwsSolutions-IAM5

user_prompt: We need a CloudFormation template that deploys a Docker-based worker service for a voting application to AWS Fargate. The template accepts parameters for all required external infrastructure: the target ECS cluster name, an ECS task execution role ARN, a Fargate security group ID, two public subnet IDs, an Application Auto Scaling role ARN, and a Redis host endpoint. The service also accepts optional parameters for a MongoDB URI and a custom IAM role. Configure the Fargate task definition with 1024 CPU units and 2048 MB of memory, running 2 initial copies, with environment variables for MongoDB URI and Redis host. Enable Application Auto Scaling with step scaling policies triggered by CPU utilization alarms: a scale-down alarm at 20% or lower CPU utilization that removes 1 task, and a scale-up alarm at 70% or higher CPU utilization with step adjustments adding 1 task for a 0-15% threshold breach, 2 tasks for a 15-25% breach, and 3 tasks for a breach above 25%, with a maximum of 10 tasks. Route container logs to a CloudWatch log group named using a combination of the environment name and service name.
cfn_code:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Docker Voting Worker service

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: voteapp
    Description: A name for the environment that this cloudformation will be part of.
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: worker
    Description: A name for the service
  ImageUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: worker
    Description: The url of a docker image that contains the application process
  ContainerCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1024
    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU
  ContainerMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2048
    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: How many copies of the service task to run
  Role:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: (Optional) An IAM role to give the service's containers
  MongoUri:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: (Optional) Mongo URI
  # --- New Parameters to replace Fn::ImportValue ---
  EcsTaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the ECS Task Execution Role
  RedisHostEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Description: Endpoint address of the Redis cluster
  EcsClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the target ECS Cluster
  FargateSecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
    Description: Security Group ID for the Fargate containers
  PublicSubnetOneId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: ID of the first public subnet
  PublicSubnetTwoId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: ID of the second public subnet
  ApplicationAutoscalingRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for Application AutoScaling

Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [ !Equals [!Ref 'Role', ''] ]

Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Join ['-', [!Ref 'EnvironmentName', 'service', !Ref 'ServiceName']]

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
      Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref 'EcsTaskExecutionRoleArn'
      TaskRoleArn:
        Fn::If:
          - 'HasCustomRole'
          - !Ref 'Role'
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref 'ServiceName'
          Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
          Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
          Image: !Ref 'ImageUrl'
          Environment:
            - Name: MONGO_URI
              Value: !Ref 'MongoUri'
            - Name: REDIS_HOST
              Value: !Ref 'RedisHostEndpoint'
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: 'awslogs'
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Join ['-', [!Ref 'EnvironmentName', 'service', !Ref 'ServiceName']]
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref 'ServiceName'

  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cluster: !Ref 'EcsClusterName'
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
      DesiredCount: !Ref 'DesiredCount'
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref 'FargateSecurityGroupId'
          Subnets:
            - !Ref 'PublicSubnetOneId'
            - !Ref 'PublicSubnetTwoId'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref 'TaskDefinition'

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: Service
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: 'ecs'
      ScalableDimension: 'ecs:service:DesiredCount'
      ResourceId: !Join ['/', ['service', !Ref 'EcsClusterName', !Ref 'ServiceName']]
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !Ref 'ApplicationAutoscalingRoleArn'

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Join ['/', ['scale', !Ref 'EnvironmentName', !Ref 'ServiceName', 'down']]
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ResourceId: !Join ['/', ['service', !Ref 'EcsClusterName', !Ref 'ServiceName']]
      ScalableDimension: 'ecs:service:DesiredCount'
      ServiceNamespace: 'ecs'
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: 'ChangeInCapacity'
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1
        MetricAggregationType: 'Average'
        Cooldown: 60

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Join ['/', ['scale', !Ref 'EnvironmentName', !Ref 'ServiceName', 'up']]
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ResourceId: !Join ['/', ['service', !Ref 'EcsClusterName', !Ref 'ServiceName']]
      ScalableDimension: 'ecs:service:DesiredCount'
      ServiceNamespace: 'ecs'
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: 'ChangeInCapacity'
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
        MetricAggregationType: 'Average'
        Cooldown: 60

  LowCpuUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Join ['-', ['low-cpu', !Ref 'EnvironmentName', !Ref 'ServiceName']]
      AlarmDescription: !Join [' ', ["Low CPU utilization for service", !Ref 'ServiceName', "in stack", !Ref 'EnvironmentName']]
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref 'ServiceName'
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref 'EcsClusterName'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

  HighCpuUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Join ['-', ['high-cpu', !Ref 'EnvironmentName', !Ref 'ServiceName']]
      AlarmDescription: !Join [' ', ["High CPU utilization for service", !Ref 'ServiceName', "in stack", !Ref 'EnvironmentName']]
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref 'ServiceName'
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref 'EcsClusterName'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy
